obligations.title: Fresh attempt workspace and owner binding
obligations.pass_condition: Attempt-owned writable view binds attempt/generation/responsibility; no prior writer/view reuse.

obligations.title: Attempt grant and durable fence
obligations.pass_condition: All work/resources bind attempt ID, lineage, responsibility; stale events rejected; fence retained until clean proof.

obligations.title: Restart discovery and quarantine records
obligations.pass_condition: Stable identity discovery; known FENCE/RECONCILE/CLEAN/VERIFY; ambiguous QUARANTINE/BLOCK_REUSE.

obligations.title: Attempt-private storage, hidden objects and capacity bounds
obligations.pass_condition: Byte/inode limits owned; all inode/FD/mount/backing refs accounted and verified absent.

obligations.title: Process/cgroup/namespace enforcement and version proof
obligations.pass_condition: All descendants/process/cgroup/namespace/network/resource classes observed; proof bound to 0.162.1.

obligations.title: Bearer nondisclosure over every channel
obligations.pass_condition: Positive and negative controls show only selected app-server reads access token; refresh remains host-only.
obligations.failure_disposition: Known/uncertain disclosure -> CLEANUP_UNVERIFIED -> QUARANTINED -> BLOCK_UNSAFE_REUSE; old token may remain valid.

obligations.title: SIWC registration enrollment and account separation
obligations.pass_condition: Verified sub/client/host ID/scopes and separate record persist; no T3Code auth.json import.
obligations.failure_disposition: Failure leaves registration inactive; no cross-account fallback.

obligations.title: Credential-set generation, serialized refresh and crash-safe rotation
obligations.pass_condition: Replacement generation atomic/recoverable; ambiguous/persist failure blocks dispatch.
obligations.failure_disposition: No blind retry; CREDENTIAL_STATE_UNCERTAIN or REAUTH_REQUIRED.

obligations.title: Attempt access materialization and conditional cross-attempt reuse
obligations.pass_condition: sub/aud/client/scope/iss/iat/exp/jti/nbf valid; prior writers/descendants/FDs/state/network absent; no disclosure.
obligations.failure_disposition: Without proof or if suspected exposure, do not reuse; quarantine as required.

obligations.title: Revocation, reauth and secret-free operator state
obligations.pass_condition: Exception-only reauth; no attempt login and no automatic alternate subscription.
obligations.failure_disposition: Block selected registration; local deletion is not remote revocation.

obligations.title: OAuth callback, state/nonce/PKCE and identity verification
obligations.pass_condition: Only verified token set persists.

obligations.title: Model egress, DNS/TLS and /v1/models denial
obligations.pass_condition: DNS/TLS/route enforcement; descendants no raw sockets; app-server works with models route denied.

obligations.title: Five Plane tools and mutation reconciliation
obligations.pass_condition: Bounded args/results; stale attempt rejected; ambiguity reconciled without blind retry.

obligations.title: SourceControl read-only binding and unselected tool exclusion
obligations.pass_condition: Only named read tool appears and is repo/candidate bound.

obligations.title: Writer fence, exact local candidate and safety validation
obligations.pass_condition: No writer survives; same exact tree is resolved, staged, validated and rechecked.

obligations.title: Bounded host publisher and credential scope
obligations.pass_condition: Only nonprotected host-managed branch and work-item PR are mutated.

obligations.title: Publication record, restart reconciliation and fresh CandidateRef
obligations.pass_condition: Unique branch/PR association and exact SHA/tree corroborated; no duplicate PR/blind retry.
obligations.failure_disposition: Unresolved -> block work item publication and escalate.

obligations.title: Checks/review/human merge/CompletionProof exact identity
obligations.acceptance_owner: SourceControl, independent reviewer, human merge authority
obligations.pass_condition: Any movement invalidates checks/review; merged tree matches candidate; CompletionProof bound.

obligations.title: No generic output/handoff promotion; scanner unchanged
obligations.pass_condition: Only exact validated tree enters GitHub candidate; outside files rejected.

obligations.title: Secret-free logs, crash/core, host evidence and diagnostics
obligations.pass_condition: Redaction and cleanup evidence binds exact attempt/resource without token content.

obligations.title: Process and host capacity bounds
obligations.pass_condition: Each boundary enforced; aggregate reserve/admission owner defined.

obligations.title: Persist topology selection and both H100 provenance/lock facts
obligations.pass_condition: Later repository record preserves both; task lock remains scope for this task.

obligations.title: Claim-specific evidence transfer review
obligations.pass_condition: Transfer and non-transfer listed; no historical evidence overstated.

obligations.title: T3Code evidence boundary
obligations.pass_condition: Symphony-owned independent records; no cross-account client/token mix.

obligations.title: Secret-free host diagnostics and evidence controls
obligations.pass_condition: Synthetic secret controls show logs/config/core/operator evidence contain no token or refresh value; exact attempt/resource evidence remains attributable.
obligations.failure_disposition: Known or uncertain disclosure -> CLEANUP_UNVERIFIED -> QUARANTINED -> block reuse.

obligations.title: Provider request/effect record and ambiguous-result retention
obligations.pass_condition: Record supports ADMITTED_LOCALLY/SENT_UPSTREAM/accepted-if-evidenced/stream/completed/failure/interrupted/ambiguous and safe restart reconciliation.
obligations.failure_disposition: Uncertain outcome remains RESULT_AMBIGUOUS; do not infer cancellation or retry blindly.

transfers.original_scope: HOST credential/channel constraint in original Symphony configuration.
transfers.transferred_property: Credential ownership stays host-side; runtime cannot redirect trusted credentialed transport. Does not prove SIWC materialization/nondisclosure/publisher.
transfers.non_transferred_property: SIWC, access-bearer confinement, new GitHub publisher are not tested claims.

transfers.transferred_property: RuntimeAttempt identity and stale-event scope transfer; filesystem/process/token isolation does not.
transfers.non_transferred_property: No fresh workspace or process containment proof.

transfers.transferred_property: Bound startup/suspension reconciliation transfers; no restore of live attempt, credential or new resource.

transfers.original_scope: Workspace OwnershipLedger ownership and shutdown recovery.
transfers.transferred_property: Trusted workspace owner/lifecycle transfers; fresh attempt writable instance is not proved.
transfers.non_transferred_property: No RuntimeAttempt binding in ownership record.

transfers.transferred_property: Accepted runtime isolation remains in scope for tested Codex 0.159.3; required 0.162.1 proof is separate.
transfers.non_transferred_property: SIWC bearer, selected egress, fresh workspace, publisher. H080B acceptance/design remain intact.
Production completeness, different executable, hidden objects, SIWC.

transfers.transferred_property: Fixture cases may inform later checks; R4 remains unaccepted.
transfers.non_transferred_property: Production output architecture, generic publication, Gate2 acceptance.
Host enforcement, actual provider credential, raw lineage acceptance.

transfers.transferred_property: Troubleshooting context only; lineage partial, acceptance authority no.
transfers.non_transferred_property: Proof completion, Gate2 acceptance, execution authorization.

transfers.transferred_property: Registration/client/host identity, token claims/lifetimes/rotation/serialization, endpoint and app-server token/restart contract. Does not prove Symphony implementation.
transfers.non_transferred_property: Local persistence, atomicity implementation, nondisclosure, Gate2 execution.

transfers.transferred_property: Only separate subscription identities may coexist on a host.
transfers.non_transferred_property: auth.json import, shadow HOME, shared DB/session/config/env do not transfer.

transfers.original_scope: V1 exact candidate model and user-selected publication boundary.
transfers.transferred_property: CandidateRef/check/review/human merge remain; host publisher owner fixed. Existing SourceControl does not create commit/push/PR.
transfers.non_transferred_property: No publisher implementation or recovery record currently exists.

transfers.source: Pinned Unified Roadmap vs supplied Gate2 lock
transfers.original_scope: Roadmap provenance plus current task lock.
transfers.transferred_property: Main records H100 active; supplied lock prohibits H100 execution in this task; preserve both.
transfers.non_transferred_property: No H100/H110/H120B execution authorization from packet.
